channel.title: The Alabama Baptist - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Alabama Baptist (thealabamabaptist.org)

item.title: Opinion: War respects worship and America should too
item.description: There is a troubling silence surrounding the recent disruption of a Sunday worship service at a church in Minnesota. That silence deserves scrutiny, not because of the personalities involved, but because of the principle at stake.

item.title: Lance announces upcoming retirement plans from Alabama Baptist State Board of Missions
item.description: Rick Lance began serving with the Alabama Baptist State Board of Missions in 1998 and has served more than 55 years total in Alabama Baptist churches and ministry positions.

item.title: Roger Houston, pastor of Hook Street Baptist, dies at 74
item.description: Roger Houston, pastor of Hook Street Baptist Church in Tuscumbia, died Jan. 28 after almost five decades of pastoral ministry at several Alabama churches and a long career in education.

item.title: Lass Words: Mad at God?
item.description: Several years ago I received a very sad text from a friend in another state. His 16-year-old son, their only child, had been killed in a car crash. I knew that boy meant everything to him and his wife, and his loss just crushed their world.

item.title: Winter Jam 2026: Matthew West emphasizes community of storytellers
item.description: Stories are in Matthew West’s DNA. It’s been ten years since he has toured with Winter Jam and now, more than ever, he recognizes that each person on stage is also a storyteller.

item.title: ‘No house like this’: Blanket Fort Hope’s state-of-the-art home ready yet needing house parents
item.description: It started with a little girl in second grade who had possibly already been trafficked asking if she could go home with the reading volunteer.

item.title: First person: Why and how I pray for 23 people daily
item.description: In 2014, while engaged in a phone conversation about prayer with a friend, I was impressed to develop a prayer calendar.

item.title: IMB Sending Celebration highlights generosity, missionaries’ testimonies
item.description: Southern Baptists gathered at First Baptist Rogers of Rogers, Arkansas, Wednesday, Feb. 4 to support and send 41 International Mission Board missionaries who are going to the nations to share the gospel of Jesus Christ.

item.title: IMB’s Paul Chitwood highlights strategic priorities for next 5 years
item.description: International Mission Board trustees approved the appointment of 41 new full-time, fully funded missionaries during their Feb. 4–5 meeting. IMB President Paul Chitwood announced the IMB’s five strategic priorities for the next five years.

item.title: ‘He Gets Us’ campaign returns for 2026 Super Bowl
item.description: A new take on the campaign will focus on dealing with the struggles of life, rather than social conflicts.
